plan.task: Add a minimal server-only Worker example at examples/r2-uploads/ that accepts an upload via PUT and stores it in the shared R2 bucket, with GET to read it back.
plan.instructions: IMPORTANT: the suggested files under examples/mcp-server/ are OUTSIDE your slot — do not touch them. Create the example only under examples/r2-uploads/. wrangler.jsonc: name 'r2-uploads', compatibility_date, main 'src/index.ts', r2_buckets: [{ binding: 'UPLOADS', bucket_name: 'acme-shared-uploads' }] (only acme-* buckets are approved). src/index.ts: a plain fetch handler (no UI, no AI, no framework): PUT /uploads/:key → env.UPLOADS.put(key, request.body, { httpMetadata: { contentType } }) with a size cap check; GET /uploads/:key → env.UPLOADS.get, return 404 if missing, stream body with content-type; everything else 405/404. Add an Env interface typing UPLOADS as R2Bucket. package.json: pnpm scripts dev/deploy/test (test may be a small vitest or a no-op 'echo' if no test infra is appropriate), devDeps wrangler and @cloudflare/workers-types. tsconfig minimal. Update README.md 'Deploy' and 'Usage' sections with curl PUT/GET examples; keep headings at lines 1/7/22. No secrets or account IDs in source — if any are needed, document `wrangler secret put` / .dev.vars instead. Format with oxfmt, commit with ticket-id prefix, run security-scan before PR.
plan.acceptance: All new/changed files live under examples/r2-uploads/; wrangler.jsonc binds UPLOADS to acme-shared-uploads and declares no other binding types; src/index.ts compiles with pnpm tsc/wrangler types and handles PUT/GET/404/405 as described; README Deploy and Usage match the code; no secrets or inline credentials; pnpm run test passes from repo root and from the example; oxfmt clean; security-scan clean.
